# Yarnboard

> Yarnboard organizes knitting and crochet patterns into a to-do list. Save a pattern from a web page, a PDF, a photo or Stitch Fiddle, tick off rows as you work, keep it private, share it with friends, or post free patterns to the community.

Yarnboard is a single-page web app. Public pages work without an account; saving, uploading and tracking patterns need a free account. Pattern text can be translated between English and Hebrew.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.yarnboard.net/): what Yarnboard does and how to start
- [Community patterns](https://www.yarnboard.net/community): free patterns other users chose to share publicly
- [Add a pattern](https://www.yarnboard.net/submit): import from a link, PDF, photo or pasted text
- [Terms of use](https://www.yarnboard.net/terms): rules for using the site and for sharing patterns

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://www.yarnboard.net/sitemap.xml)
- [AI catalog](https://www.yarnboard.net/ai-catalog.json): the same overview as JSON
